Content: Read the excerpt about the `2021` Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act.

:box:The Bipartisan Infrastructure Deal’s more than `text($65 billion)` investment includes the largest investment in clean energy transmission and grid in American history. It will upgrade our power infrastructure . . . while lowering costs. And it will fund new programs to support the development, demonstration, and deployment of cutting-edge clean energy technologies to accelerate our transition to a zero-emission economy.

	Source: whitehouse.gov
Which phrase explains a `ultext(primary)` goal of federal investments such as those described in the excerpt?

A.Choice: to address unemployment by extending benefits

B.Choice: to promote change by enacting trade embargoes

C.Choice: to increase revenue by supporting local businesses

D.Choice: to encourage economic growth by contributing to advancements

Key.Rationale: A primary goal of federal investments like the `2021` Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act is to encourage economic growth by contributing to advancements.

Content: Read the excerpt from the Constitution of the United States.
:box:All Bills for raising Revenue shall originate in the House of Representatives.
Which statement `ultext(best)` justifies this provision of the Constitution?

A.Choice: The House of Representatives responds to the needs of constituents.

Key.Rationale: Bills originate in the House of Representatives because “the House of Representatives responds to the needs of constituents.”

B.Choice: The House of Representatives holds more power than the other chamber.

C.Choice: The House of Representatives frequently interacts with the executive branch.

D.Choice: The House of Representatives needs a way to check the power of the judicial branch.

Content: Based on both maps, which factor `ultext(most)` explains the population patterns in Africa?

A.Choice: People build homes near sources of mineral wealth and mining jobs.

Key.Rationale: This option does not explain the population patterns in Africa.

B.Choice: Technology has allowed people to build larger cities in central deserts.

Key.Rationale: This option does not explain the population patterns in Africa.

C.Choice: Extreme temperatures are beneficial for building large population centers.

Key.Rationale: This option does not explain the population patterns in Africa.

D.Choice: Many densely populated areas are near large sources of navigable fresh water.

Content: Read the excerpt from a report by the Congressional Research Service about the growing market for electric vehicles (EVs).

:box:The potential for an accelerating global transition to EVs leads some to question the availability of the minerals and materials needed to build EV batteries, especially as some mineral requirements (and availability) vary greatly by battery type. Some have raised questions that are beyond the scope of this report, including questions framing such growth . . . as a potential opportunity for increased human rights abuses . . . and as a potential threat for increased environmental destruction.
Which situation `ultext(best)` describes an unintended negative consequence of the growth of the EV market?

A.Choice: the decline in the production of petroleum

B.Choice: the lowering of greenhouse gas emissions

C.Choice: the ecological damage from mineral mines

Key.Rationale: An unintended negative consequence of the growth of the EV market is the ecological damage from mineral mines.

D.Choice: the development of new charging technology

Content: Read the excerpt from the Gettysburg Address.

:box:It is rather for us, the living, we here dedicated to the great task remaining before us — that, from these honored dead we take increased devotion to that cause for which they here, gave the last full measure of devotion — that we here highly resolve that these dead shall not have died in vain; that the nation, shall have a new birth of freedom, and that government of the people[,] by the people[,] for the people, shall not perish from the earth.

	—President Abraham Lincoln, Gettysburg Address, `text(November 19, 1863)`
How did President Lincoln’s point of view affect his writing?

A.Choice: As president of the United States, he sought to negotiate a peace proposal.

B.Choice: As general of the victorious army, he sought new recruits to replace the men lost in the battle.

C.Choice: As commander in chief of the victorious army, he sought to inspire the living and honor the dead.

Key.Rationale: As commander in chief of the victorious army, he sought to inspire the living and honor the dead.

D.Choice: As president of the United States, he sought to encourage lawmakers to provide more supplies for troops.

Content: Read the excerpts from a speech and an information manual.

:box:It was we, the people; not we, the white male citizens; nor yet we, the male citizens; but we, the whole people, who formed the Union. And we formed it, not to give the blessings of liberty, but to secure them; not to the `text(half)` of ourselves and the `text(half)` of our posterity, but to the whole people — women as well as men. And it is a downright mockery to talk to women of their enjoyment of the blessings of liberty while they are denied the use of the only means of securing them provided by this democratic-republican government — the ballot.

	—from a speech given by Susan B. Anthony in `1873` regarding her conviction for voting illegally

:box:Suffrage is not a right. It is a privilege that may or may not be granted. Politics is no place for a woman consequently the privilege should not be granted to her. The mother’s influence is needed in the home. She can do little good by gadding the streets and neglecting her children. Let her teach her daughters that modesty, patience, and gentleness are the charms of a woman. Let her teach her sons that an honest conscience is every man’s `text(first)` political law.

	—from the appendix “Argument Against Women’s Suffrage” in a California voters’ information manual, `1911`
Which phrase describes the `ultext(most)` likely reason for the contrast in viewpoints represented in the excerpts?

A.Choice: differing access to enriching cultural experiences

B.Choice: differing access to profitable economic opportunities

C.Choice: differing opinions about the role of gender in American society

Key.Rationale: The most likely reason for the contrast in viewpoints in the excerpts is differing opinions about the role of gender in American society.

D.Choice: differing ways of interpreting the founding documents of America

Content: Read the information in the box.

:box:For over `text(200 years)`, the shogunate (hereditary military dictatorship) government of Japan had kept the nation isolated from the rest of the world. In `1853`, Commodore Matthew Perry of the United States took a fleet of steamships to Japan to present a letter from the president to the emperor of Japan, asking to open trade between the `text(two)` nations. While Perry’s fleet was in Japan, officials of the Japanese government often visited the ships to learn about the steam engines, ask questions about the “steam engines that ran on roads through mountains” (railroads), and fire the different types of guns and weapons onboard the ships.
Based on the reaction of the Japanese officials described in the passage, which action were they `ultext(most likely)` interested in taking?

A.Choice: building bonds of trade with other nations

Key.Rationale: Based on the reaction of the Japanese officials described in the passage, the Japanese were most likely interested in industrializing their economy and military.

C.Choice: changing to a democratic form of government

D.Choice: learning the beliefs and traditions of other nations

Content: Banks and factories are both economic institutions. Which statement `ultext(best)` describes the difference between banks and factories?

A.Choice: A factory provides income for workers, while a bank collects taxes on the income.

B.Choice: A factory produces goods and provides services, while a bank offers incentives to work.

C.Choice: A factory employs `text(hundreds)` of people, while a bank handles the payroll for employees.

D.Choice: A factory generates jobs and goods, while a bank keeps money safe and available for investment.

Key.Rationale: A factory generates jobs and goods, while a bank keeps money safe and available for investment.
